title: Payment Standing Points Added to TimeBank Extension Fees
content:
Extension standing schedule of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours. Points are added to the extension fee percentage according to the block's payment record:

- when a late fee has been assessed on the block in the twelve months before signing, meaning fees dated after the same day twelve months earlier, 2 points are added to the percentage;
- when no such late fee was assessed but the block invoice was paid in full more than the size's invoice-due number of days after it was posted, or still stands unpaid or only partly paid more than that number of days after it was posted, 1 point is added;
- otherwise none.

Only payments applied to the block invoice's own invoice number count toward it, and a payment completing the invoice dates its full payment. The invoice-due number of days is that of the block's size (0 on the 10-Hour and 20-Hour Blocks, 15 on the 40-Hour and 80-Hour Blocks, 30 on the 160-Hour and 320-Hour Blocks).

| Late fee in the twelve months | Block invoice | Points |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | any | 2 |
| none | paid in full more than the due days after posting | 1 |
| none | unpaid or partly paid, and more than the due days have passed since posting | 1 |
| none | paid in full within the due days, or unpaid with the due days not yet passed | none |

Hypothetical case on a 40-Hour Block (15 due days): an invoice posted 1 March and completed on 16 March was paid on day 15 and adds none; completed on 17 March, day 16, it adds 1 point. A 6 percent fee percentage with 1 point becomes 7 percent.
